purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Suna West Form 34B and preserve a genuine missing-field source gap without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: Rendered at 400 DPI (3-page official IEBC Form 34B PDF; page 2 of 3 ends the polling-station table with a row labelled 'TOTAL REGISTERED'). Every individual polling-station row on this page prints a Rejected Ballots figure in the rightmost column, but the TOTAL REGISTERED row's own Rejected Ballots cell is confirmed blank -- an empty ruled box, not a faint or illegible digit -- at 400 DPI.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL REGISTERED row was read directly from the rendered page image at 200 DPI and again at 400 DPI, with identical results. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same TOTAL REGISTERED row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-256-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), sourced from the pre-election official IEBC First Schedule registered-voters gazette, published 2022-06-21

note: Total Valid Votes and the four candidate cells are individually clear and internally reconcile on the printed TOTAL REGISTERED row (candidate sum 42,327 + 795 + 15 + 57 = 43,194, matching the row's own printed Total Valid Votes). However, this row's own Rejected Ballots cell is confirmed blank at 400 DPI -- unlike every individual polling-station row above it, which does print a rejected-ballots figure -- so rejected_ballots is not evidenced on the source for this constituency total, matching the Narok South and Kajiado East precedent from an earlier tranche. Separately and independently, the row's printed Registered Voters figure (56,788) also does not match the governed P23 denominator (56,686), a 102-voter gap for which no explaining special-facility polling station was identified on the page. Either defect alone would block promotion; per the extraction contract all three target fields must be source_verified before promotion, so this row is recorded as verification_state=partial_unresolved rather than assuming a rejected-ballots value (e.g. zero) not actually printed on the source.
